mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_devices (user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth_secret) VALUES (#{userId}, #{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{authSecret}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = new.user_id, p256dh = new.p256dh, auth_secret = new.auth_secret
mapper.select: SELECT device_id AS deviceId, endpoint, p256dh, auth_secret AS authSecret FROM notification_devices WHERE user_id = #{userId}
